sentences.text:
The brief facts of the prosecution case are that:
 That on 07-08-2022 at about 6.30 p.m., at Park View Bar, 50 feet Road, Muneshwara Block, Girinagar, Bengaluru the accused No.1 and 2 with common intention picked up quarrel with CW 2 and 3 with regard to paying the bill for liquor consumed by them and abused them in filthy language knowingly that it would give provocation to CW-1 and 5 to breach public peace and assaulted CW 2 with a glass tumbler on his forehead and caused simple bleeding injuries and thereby accused persons have committed aforesaid offences.
 3. The accused No.1 and 2 were enlarged on bail.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took the cognizance of the alleged  3  C.C.No.5085/2023 offence and furnished copy of the prosecution papers to the accused persons.
Charge for the offences P/U/S. 324, 504 r/w/s 34 IPC. was framed, read over and explained to the accused No.1 and 2.
Accused No.1 and 2 pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
Thereafter the matter was posted for evidence.
Later accused persons remained absent and failed to appeared before the court.
Proclamation and attachment was issued against the accused on many occasions and was returned unexecuted.
As accused No.1 and 2 was traced and hence, case is restored and after appearance of accused No.1 and 2, they were enlarged on bail in this case .

4. In support of the case of prosecution, in spite of Girinagar Police Station vs Praveen Kumar on 5 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129829687/
2 repeated issuance of summons and warrants the jurisdictional police failed to secure the presence of CW 1 to 8.

As none of the witnesses are examined by the prosecution and no evidence against the accused NO.1 and 2, the recording of  4  C.C.No.5085/2023 Statement of Accused as required U/s. 313 of Cr.P.C., is dispensed with.
 5.
I have heard the arguments of learned Sr.APP., for the prosecution and learned counsel for the accused.
Perused the materials available on record.

6. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that on 07-08-2022 at about 6.30 p.m., at Park  View Bar, 50 feet Road, Muneshwara Block, Girinagar,
 Bengaluru the accused No.1 and 2 with common  intention picked up quarrel with CW 2 and 3 with  regard to paying the bill for liquor consumed by them  and abused them in filthy language knowingly that it  would give provocation to CW-1 and 5 to breach public  peace and assaulted CW 2 with a glass tumbler on his  forehead and caused simple bleeding injuries and  thereby accused have committed the offences punishable  U/s.324, 504 r/w/s 34 IPC.?
 2) what order?
 7.

My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 5  C.C.No.5085/2023  REASONS  8.

The witnesses cited in the charge sheet did not appeared and lead their evidence and there are no materials against accused as Cws. 1 to 8 were not secured by the prosecution,
accordingly they were dropped.

This court issued summons,
Girinagar Police Station vs Praveen Kumar on 5 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129829687/
3 warrant and proclamation to Cws.1 to 8.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: But the concerned police could not secure the presence of the witnesses in-spite of issuance of several times process by this court.
The Cws.1 to 8 may not be secured in near future days.
Hence, prayer of Sr.APP to reissue witness summons to Cw's was rejected and CW-1 to 8 were dropped and prosecution side evidence is taken as Nil.
Since there was no incriminating evidence against the accused, the statement of accused U/s.313 of Cr.P.C. was dispensed with.
In the absence of evidence of Cws.1 to 8, there are no material to show that the accused No.1 has committed the offence punishable U/s. 324, 504 r/w/s 34 IPC.
Hence, I hold that the prosecution has utterly failed to prove  6  C.C.No.5085/2023 the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
9. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following;
 ORDER Acting Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., accused No.1 and 2 are hereby acquitted of the offences punishable U/s.324, 504 r/w/s 34 IPC.
The bail bond and surety bond of accused No.1 and 2 shall stand canceled.

(Dictated to the Stenographer directly on the computer and print out taken by her is verified,
corrected & then pronounced by me in the Open Court dated this the 05-12-2025).
(SYED ARFATH IBRAHIM M.) XXXVII ADDL.C.J.M., Bengaluru.
